digest.component_or_area: LLM provider infrastructure / OpenAI Responses API readiness
propositions: Pydantic-ai 1.107.2 constructs real OpenAIResponsesModel for openai-responses: prefix, but four rebar code sites (config.py KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, providers.py is_resolvable, capabilities.py _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, and openai:/openai-chat: normalizers) block runtime invocation and must be unblocked in ticket 155c.

Contract tests in tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py prove structured-output, streaming, tool-call, retry, and custom-base-URL routing work identically under both openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes by parameterizing real pydantic-ai model construction against a MockTransport stub.

Hosted OpenAI (openai:/openai-chat:) is Responses-ready under the pin; all other endpoints (custom base_url builders, gateway/openai, deepseek, xai, groq, grok, cerebras, moonshotai, heroku) are Chat-Completions-only or UNKNOWN, per the capability matrix.

ProviderSession._build_openai and per-candidate endpoint override registration are keyed only to openai/openai-chat, making custom base_url and endpoint-override rows Chat-Completions-only regardless of vendor-side /v1/responses support.

xai: and groq: endpoints cannot be classified (no construction path testable under absent SDK extras) and require future evidence when upstream pydantic-ai adds third-party Responses construction paths.

The openai: → openai-chat: normalizers (anthropic_model.py and model_classes.py) hard-code the Chat pin and must be revisited if the default flips to prevent openai: strings from bypassing any new Responses default.
